Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-14 ER 2; TFA-92592 AC 2 + AC 4 · “Generate does not run task extraction again (PR #50).”. Mixed: stated part — Generate adds, closes and re-opens nothing; one task per action item; our part — Save & Extract pressed twice in a row (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S06 Save & Extract pressed 0, 1 or 2 times, with or without new dictation, then Generate: Generate never extracts and nothing is added twice

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Generate AI Note does not run task extraction again (PR #50): it never re-marks, re-adds or removes tasks. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 2; TFA-92592 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician. Per mode the first patient carries the S05 seed; the second patient has one open task 'Follow up lactate'

When Per mode, first patient: R1 type the S05 dictation, press Save & Extract once, then Generate Note & Finish. R2 append 'Repeat lactate at noon.' to the dictation and press Generate again without Save & Extract. R3 press Save & Extract twice in a row, then Generate. Second patient: R4 type 'Lactate came back 1.1. …

Then R1: the task list after Generate is exactly what Save & Extract left (same done flags, nothing added, re-opened or removed). R2: Generate adds, closes and re-opens nothing; whether the lactate order became a task is recorded (Q15). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Backend probe (rounding:get / snf:get) before and after every press: tasks arrays equal across each Generate (U3); after R3, countMatching = 1 for each action item ('clears', 'potassium', 'urine culture', 'lactate') and the metoprolol row has one change today (U2: no duplicates). …

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S06

Save & Extract pressed 0, 1 or 2 times, with or without new dictation, then Generate: Generate never extracts and nothing is added twice

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

PW, local stack, both modes, model mocked at the socket (this judges the app's wiring and de-duplication; the model's matching is S05 on dev). R1 one Save & Extract (closes BMP and PT eval, adds the diet / potassium / urine-culture tasks) then Generate: tasks identical after Generate, no extractTasks call after the press. R2 new dictation ('Repeat lactate at noon') and Regenerate without Save & Extract: nothing added, closed or re-opened, no extractTasks call. R3 two Save & Extract presses in a row, the second answered with the SAME new task and the SAME metoprolol event (worst case): one lactate / clears / potassium / urine-culture / weight task each, and (Hospital) one metoprolol event although three extractions reported it; Regenerate then leaves the list as it was. R4 second patient, Generate with no Save & Extract: 'Follow up lactate' and the list stay as seeded, no extractTasks call. Judged 13/13 (Hospital) and 12/12 (Nursing Home). Recorded (Q15): dictation added after the last Save & Extract ('Repeat lactate at noon', 'Repeat CBC tomorrow') never becomes a task, since Generate does not extract; (Q13) Nursing Home Save & Extract records no medication event. Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: oracle-same-as, action-timing. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
